scripts.prepare:launch: npm run generate:metadata && npm run generate:whitelist && npm run compile
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=hockey-nft-league --branch=main
scripts.deploy:amoy: hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/HockeyNFTLeague.ts --network polygonAmoy --deployment-id polygon-amoy
scripts.deploy:v2:amoy: hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/HockeyNFTLeagueV2.ts --network polygonAmoy --deployment-id polygon-amoy-jersey-v2 --parameters ignition/parameters.v2.amoy.json
scripts.deploy:v2:polygon: hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/HockeyNFTLeagueV2.ts --network polygon --deployment-id polygon-mainnet-jersey-v2 --parameters ignition/parameters.v2.polygon.json
